newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Support for NZ First slips in TV3 political poll.
newsitem.headline: Support for NZ First slips in TV3 political poll.

text.p: Support for the opposition New Zealand First party slipped three points to 15 percent in a TV3 political poll released on Monday.

Meanwhile, support for the ruling National party was steady on 38 percent and, critically, support for its potential coalition partners the Christian Coalition and ACT party climbed to 5.8 percent and 4.6 percent respectively.
A party must gain at least five percent of party support to enter parliament, unless one of its candidates can win in one of the 65 individual constituencies.
The main opposition centre-left Labour party slipped two points in the poll to 19 percent party support, while the left-wing Alliance gained one to 13.
A general election will be held on October 12 under a new system of proportional representation, which is conducive to coalition or minority government.
